title: ChangeWatch monitoring
description: Monitor public HTML pages. Keep the same client ID and URLs across runs to compare snapshots.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Unique, permanent lowercase kebab-case identifier, e.g. client-acme. ASCII letters/digits separated by single hyphens; no spaces. Invalid forms are rejected, never silently renamed. Reusing an ID shares snapshots.

competitors.title: Competitor pages
competitors.description: Add a competitor name and full HTTP or HTTPS page URL for each page to monitor (up to 100).

url.title: Competitor URL
url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS page URL.

ignore_selectors.title: Ignore CSS selectors
ignore_selectors.description: Optional selectors removed before text and product extraction, e.g. .cookie-banner or .carousel. Invalid rules are skipped with a warning.

ignore_text_patterns.title: Ignore text patterns
ignore_text_patterns.description: Optional regular expressions removed from individual visible text nodes. Invalid patterns are skipped with a warning. Use narrow patterns to avoid removing product information.

alert_threshold.title: Alert threshold
alert_threshold.description: Generate alerts only for changed pages scoring at least this value (0–100).

client_email.title: Client email (optional)
client_email.description: One recipient. Leave empty to generate alert text without sending email. Requires Resend environment configuration.

language.title: Alert language
language.description: Language for deterministic alert templates. Original page excerpts remain in their source language.

timezone.title: Client timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone for email timestamps, for example Europe/Paris, America/New_York or UTC. Dataset timestamps remain UTC.

confirmation_runs.title: Confirmation runs (optional override)
confirmation_runs.description: Leave unset for automatic defaults: 1 for stable ID/URL entity changes, 2 for other changes. Set only to override all change types.

alert_cooldown_hours.title: Identical alert cooldown (hours)
alert_cooldown_hours.description: Suppress identical sent fingerprints during this period unless an intervening accepted state makes it a genuine new change. Unchanged pages never resend automatically.
